audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart said Skill/Kayle/Kayle/Skill/Skill/Kayle/Kayle while the prose and the packet chart both say Ryze owns levels 1-3 and reclaims the 2+ item window.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Ryze,Ryze,Ryze,Kayle,Kayle,Kayle,Ryze; whys[0..2] describe Ryze killing an escape-less Kayle and whys[6] hands the last row to full-build Ryze.
audit.corrected: Chart flipped to Ryze,Ryze,Ryze,Kayle,Kayle,Kayle,Ryze in both layers with matching ratings.

audit.why: Spikes are level 6 (Divine Ascent ranged autos + Divine Judgment), Nashor's/level 11, and Ryze at 2+ items — all consistent with both kits.

audit.whatIsWrong: Text repeatedly said Ryze's E roots, and claimed 'his shield blanks your Q poke'. Ryze has no shield in his current kit, and E (Spell Flux) does not root.
audit.why: Riot text: Spell Flux (E) debuffs with Flux; Rune Prison (W) slows, and roots only if the target already has Flux. Overload (Q) is reset by his other basic abilities on a 5s base cooldown.
audit.corrected: All root references now read Spell Flux (E) into Rune Prison (W); the shield claim is removed and replaced with Rune Prison's 11s rank-1 cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere.
audit.why: Rune Prison is 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s and only roots off Flux, so dodging E is the whole defensive game.
audit.corrected: Added the 11s number and the Flux prerequisite to the cooldown breakdown and the do's.

edits.before: Ryze lands E to root you in place while you are melee-range with no escape and no R to save you.
edits.after: Spell Flux (E) then Rune Prison (W) roots you — melee-range, no escape, and no R to save you.

edits.before: He bursts with Q and chains the reset off the procced root while his W slow keeps you pinned, winning a trade you cannot answer at level 2.
edits.after: Overload (Q) resets off every other spell on a 5s base cooldown, so Flux-into-root chains Q twice before you can answer a trade at level 2.

edits.before: His shield blanks your Q poke and a fresh root-into-Q all-in can simply kill an escape-less Kayle here.
edits.after: Rune Prison is back every 11s at rank 1, and a fresh Flux-into-root all-in kills an escape-less Kayle here.

edits.before: Ryze's E root into Q burst chunks you while you are melee-range and escape-less, and he can chain Q resets off the procced root — his hardest window to punish you.
edits.after: Spell Flux (E) into Rune Prison (W) is the root — un-Fluxed, W only slows. Rooted, he chains Overload resets off a 5s cooldown while you are melee-range and escape-less.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are your nightmare and his playground. You are melee-range and escape-less, and Ryze chunks you by landing E to root, then bursting with Q and chaining the reset off the procced root while you can't fight back — eat that combo and you die. Don't try to trade: stand at max Q (Radiant Blast) range, farm what you safely can, and concede CS rather than walking into his root setup. His shield soaks your poke, so just survive to 6.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are your nightmare and his playground. You are melee-range and escape-less, and Ryze chunks you by landing Spell Flux (E) first — only then does Rune Prison (W) root instead of slow — then chaining Overload resets off a 5s cooldown while you can't fight back. Don't try to trade: stand at max Q (Radiant Blast) range, farm what you safely can, and concede CS rather than eating Flux. Un-Fluxed his W is only a slow: walk out of it.

edits.before: Land E to root you, then chain Q resets and W slow while you are melee and immobile
edits.after: Land Spell Flux so Rune Prison roots, then chain Overload resets while you are immobile

edits.before: His point-blank root — sets up his combo. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Rune Prison roots only if Spell Flux landed first — dodge the E and his W is a slow, 11s down.

edits.before: - Ryze Rune Prison: matchup-defining — His point-blank root — sets up his combo. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Ryze Rune Prison: matchup-defining — roots only after Spell Flux lands, 11s at rank 1. Dodge the E. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.

notes: Ryze has no shield in the current kit — the old 'his shield blanks your poke' line was fabricated and is removed. Root is Spell Flux (E) then Rune Prison (W); un-Fluxed W is a slow only.
